narr: Thunderstorms developed along the Mogollon Rim during the afternoon hours before pushing through Gila County by late afternoon and early evening. Additional thunderstorms developed along terrain features over the Telegraph burn scar, producing heavy rainfall over the area. This heavy rainfall resulted in downstream flash flooding in Russell Gulch. No damage or injuries were reported.
ev: Emergency management reported flash flooding in Russell Gulch that resulted in a low water crossing being closed near a medical center due to flooding. A bridge near the medical center came close to overtopping. Water also spilled out of a channel near a public works yard. No damage or injuries were reported.
